scope: Matched same-voice auxiliary phrase classification; development validation only.
hypothesis: Encouraging the shared encoder to identify complete near words can reduce binary false wakes without reducing recall.
pair_sampling: Eight pairs replace eight positive and eight TTS negative slots in each 128-row training batch in both arms. Same engine, corpus, fixed voice/preset, delivery metadata and rendering variant; exclude voice-description-only Qwen and multi-voice Piper. Independent seed 381 and same within-band phase draw; original representative inputs remain unchanged.
advance: Require identical pair schedule, validation exposure, representative inputs and exported interface. Require zero continuous development events and <=1% worst engine/corpus and engine false fraction, with at least 3 recall points over control at the same gate, or over control at the 2% limit if it has no strict point. Report the full grid and fixed .97 comparison. Keep all final sets sealed.
limits: These are synthetic voice presets; identity matching does not substitute for new speakers. A paired objective with a limited corpus is an exploratory screen, not acoustic acceptance.
objective: Both arms run the same Adam path and weighted binary BCE. A training-only four-way Dense head on the existing encoder state predicts Hey Nyx, Hey Mix, Hey Next or Hey Nick for the 16 paired items. Its mean cross entropy has gain 0 or 0.35; the head is excluded before export.
